defects: On the viewer's left of Zoubida's waist, her right cuff and hand clip slightly into the front-left edge of her orange sash.
At the bottom center-right, her hanging left hand sits against the bottom frame edge behind the subtitle.
Her overall pose is stiff and mannequin-like for declaring total war.
tiles.fix: Adjust Zoubida's arms into an active, determined stance clear of the orange sash and raised above the bottom frame edge.

defects: At far left, Zoubida faces away from the camera with her back turned, hiding her face.
Her raised left elbow touches the top frame edge while her forearm folds back behind her own head, obscuring her hand rather than reaching up toward the doorway lintel on the left.
No talisman prop is visible in her hand or over the door.
Her right arm hangs stiffly in an idle pose, her feet are hidden beneath the skirt hem, and she reads slightly oversized relative to the open wooden door panel beside her.
tiles.fix: Rotate Zoubida into a three-quarter profile facing the left doorway, extend her raised hand holding a visible talisman toward the upper door lintel well below the top frame edge, scale her down slightly against the door, and reveal her shoes grounded on the floor.

defects: In Zoubida's raised left hand (right of her torso), the white dish cloth is undersized and rigid like a folded paper triangle rather than a flexible cloth mid-whip.
Her feet and lower body are planted straight and static with no weight shift, and her right hand hovers stiffly in front of her waist sash.
Her shoes on the rug lack floor contact shadows.
tiles.fix: Enlarge and drape the dish cloth naturally from a firm grip in her left hand, add a forward weight shift in her stance with a relaxed right arm, and add floor contact shadows under her shoes.

defects: At center-right, Zoubida's extended left fingers are spread open rather than closing around the dish cloth, making the small rigid cloth appear glued to or floating off her fingertips.

Her legs and lower body stay almost identically planted from s03 48.7 with no follow-through lunge toward the window, and her right hand hovers stiffly with splayed fingers in front of her orange sash.
tiles.fix: Curl her left fingers firmly around a fuller, trailing dish cloth aimed toward the open window, shift her stance into a follow-through toward the right, and relax her right arm and fingers.

worst_problem: In s03 28.8 (b007), Zoubida turns her back to the camera and folds her raised elbow against the top frame edge behind her own head with no visible talisman instead of reaching up toward the left doorway lintel.
